mostWorthwhile.text: Using ATP with the assembled cell was most worthwhile because it connected food energy to two different cell jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the prepared protein builder felt a little repetitive after assembling it, though the inset helped connect RNA to DNA.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the same ATP supply to support both building proteins and pumping particles toward the more crowded side.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the goals and pictures explained where the parts belonged. I followed the description of RNA as a message without knowing the detailed process of making it.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: seeing the pieces become a working cell made me curious how cells connect to tissues and organs, although the placements were sometimes predictable.
